mentions.name: Smello
mentions.description: A Python library and local server that capture outgoing HTTP requests to help debug API integrations. Inspired by Mailpit, which is used to debug outgoing emails.
mentions.problem: Debugging the outgoing HTTP requests made by API integrations
mentions.audience: Debugging outgoing HTTP requests when building and testing API integrations
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Smello (https://github.com/smelloscope/smello), a Python library and a local server that capture your outgoing HTTP requests to help you debug API integrations.
